_comment: Guardrail budgets enforced by CI. Only the Director may raise these, with a DECISIONS.md entry explaining why.

smokeSeconds._comment: Wall time of each CI smoke shard (e2e/shards.mjs), checked by the smoke on CI (#353): ~1.4x its time on #364's CI run (2026-11-04), rounded up to 30 s; mobile, the longest, 1.3x so no shard can push verify far past 10 min unnoticed.

scene._comment: Per-level ceilings checked by the smoke (#188): drawCalls at the ride screenshot (camera-dependent: +20% over the higher of two runs on 2026-10-31), scene and track (objects named track*) objects and triangles from sceneStats() (camera-independent: +15%). knownOver: "#<open issue>" turns a failure into a warning until that issue lands.
